$schema_note: Wave 0 style-violation budgets for #121. Budgets never exceed the frozen baseline in VIOLATION_BUDGET_BASELINE.json; counts are capped by their budgets. CI fails if a count rises above its budget, and fails if a budget is raised above the frozen Wave 0 baseline (or a metric is added/removed without a baseline update in the same PR). Lowering a budget is always allowed and needs no baseline change. Note: 'each converging PR must lower at least one budget it touches' was the Wave 0 wording; it is not mechanically enforced in-tree and is not claimed here — the enforced rule is budgets never exceed baseline.

css_hex_outside_token_defs.description: Hex colour literals in *.css property values (lines that are not custom-property definitions).

css_rgba_outside_token_defs.description: rgba()/rgb() literals in *.css property values outside custom-property definitions.

js_hex_literals.description: Hex colour literals in demo/static *.js (canvas palettes included until Wave 1c).

spacing_outside_legacy_ladder.description: padding/margin/gap/inset px values outside {0,4,8,12,16}. Control/row ladder 24/32/40/48 is the Wave 0 decision; this metric still tracks legacy off-ladder noise until Wave 1 lint set expands.

breakpoints_outside_baseline.description: width breakpoints outside {1500,1440,1320,1279,1023}. Known: fab 1200, timeline 720.
